_comment: Offsets into the $A5-byte SRAM monster record (E-0262) that have evidence. tools/disasm_all.py writes them to src/records.inc as MON_* constants and uses them for the offset a record-access routine takes in C (E-0290). Offsets without an entry stay numeric.

0B.note: word compared with monster ids by talk events $29/$47 (C1: the species id)

0E.note: bit 0 = sex (C1): after the first parent is chosen, breeding steps back when no other listed record has a different bit 0; the record list draws mark tile $CC + bit 0 when byte $6E is 2

0F.note: the master's name, 10 bytes: ComputeBreedingChild stores the player name here (CopyPlayerNameToWCADF) and copies each parent's into the child's parent master names (E-0297); called 'second name' in E-0034

19.note: the id of the player who bred it: ComputeBreedingChild stores wPlayerId here (C1)

1A.note: species word of the first parent (from its $0B; CopySixBytesByWCADDBit4Table, the order swapped by bit 4 of $0D)

1C.note: species word of the second parent

1E.note: master name of the first parent (from its $0F; CopyFourNamesByWCADDBit4Table)

29.note: master name of the second parent

3C.note: the list AppendMappedSkillsToWCA67 appends to, up to $FF

57.note: level cap (C1): DrawRecordLevelAndStatusRow_1E loads $56-$57 as a pair and draws the cap mark $6F when the level is at least this byte

63.note: ATK word (C1: first of the stats column, raised by AddAToRecordWordCapped like $65-$69)

6B.note: WLD (wildness) word (C1): the fifth word of the stats column after ATK, DEF, AGL and INT, matching the INFO panel's order ATK, DEF, AGL, INT, WLD (E-0046); drawn by the same stat path

6D.note: the breeding plus value (C1): when non-zero, the monster's info screen (WithSRAMDraw4ACEAnd4BE8_ShowStringBank08AtTilesHL_Bank03) draws glyph $FC and the value in one or two digits after the member number; BreedMenu_CopyToChildThenTalkEvent16 copies it to the child record

6E.note: non-zero marks an egg (C1): when CountRecordsByField6E counts none the battle-end flow shows 'You have no eggs.', the egg lists (ListRecordsInUseWithByte6ESet, 'Switch which egg?') take records with it set, CreateMonsterRecordOfKindTemp1 sets it to 1 for kinds 1 and 2, and DrawRecordListPageMarks shows the sex mark only when it is 2

6F.note: four personality axes, $6F-$72, from MonsterTable bytes 22-25

73.note: 27 resistance levels: copied from species bytes $12-$2C when a record is created (CreateMonsterRecordOfKindTemp1_Sub01_LoadMonsterRecord), rolled for a child by RollChildResistancesToWCB43 and refreshed by RefreshRecordResistancesFromSpecies (E-0114, E-0127)

8E.note: name of the first parent (from its $01; CopyFourNamesByWCADDBit4Table)

98.note: plus value of the first parent (from its $6D)

A3.note: plus value of the second parent

00.note: name, 10 bytes ($FF-filled by LoadMonsterAndSpeciesForListEntryC_ReadRecordBufferAndRecordBufferData for a wild monster)

17.note: level (MonsterTable byte 9 for a wild monster)

18.note: experience, 24 bits (MonsterTable bytes 6-7 and a zero high byte for a wild monster)

4D.note: MonsterTable byte 8 for a wild monster; copied to wFoeJoinClass1-3 for the three foes, 7 stops the defeated monster from joining

2D.note: personality bytes (MonsterTable bytes 22, 23, 25, 24 in that order)

01.note: sex-ratio class: 0 = always sex 0, otherwise (byte & 3) indexes SexChanceByClass (10, 50, 90) in RollChildSexFromSpecies

04.note: join-chance class 0-7: after a battle BattleEnd_Step5_Case00_WriteBattleFoeCountAndSpeciesIdLoEtc compares (random mod 200) with the chance table entry for it; 7 = never joins

06.note: base level cap: copied to a new record's $57 (MON_MAX_LEVEL); BattleEnd_Step3 compares the level with it; ComputeBreedingChild starts the child's cap from it

08.note: three natural skills: copied to the first three entries of a new record's skill list $3C (MON_SKILL_LIST), the rest $FF

10.note: stat growth row: passed to StatFromGrowthRow and ReadStatGrowthGain (level-up gains)

12.note: 27 base resistance levels: copied to a new record's $73-$8D (MON_RESISTANCES); LoadWD01AByteArg4 reads one

01.note: 0: UpdateAndDrawSpriteSlots takes the sprite set from +2; otherwise another path

02.note: sprite id word: with OBJ_SET_MODE 0, bits 0-6 of the low byte are the set index, bit 7 selects DrawMetaSpriteSet_Bank26 and a non-zero high byte DrawMetaSpriteSet_Bank27; monster objects store the species word here (E-0300, E-0308)

09.note: animation counter: UpdateSpriteSlots type 0 increments it each frame unless +$D bit 1 is set (C1; E-0134 called it flags)

0D.note: flags (bit 1 stops the animation counter, bit 2 selects the frame rule)

0E.note: meta-sprite sub-index; bit 7 flips it horizontally (hSpriteAttrXor bit 5)

01.note: tile offset of the script meta-sprite (DrawFieldSprites)

02.note: sprite set index (bits 0-6); bit 7: a sub-index follows
